purpose: Localize the single failed GE09 source-grid validation channel using only the frozen GE09 artifact, quantify its position within accepted-step intervals, and characterize deterministic Hermite convergence under endpoint decimation without changing the GE09 threshold or representation.

frozen_representation.primary: CubicHermiteSpline on every successful accepted endpoint using fresh physical RHS/(aH) for delta_dark
frozen_representation.alternative_interpolants: PCHIP and linear may be reported descriptively at the historical worst row only; they are not replacement candidates or PASS gates

descriptive_outputs: left/right accepted endpoint states and fresh delta_dark_prime
fractional position of source row in local ln(a) interval
absolute, relative and abs-or-rel Hermite error
error normalized by local endpoint swing
global delta_dark source-validation maximum at endpoint strides 4,2,1
PCHIP and linear errors at the historical worst row
top ten primary source-grid delta_dark mismatches
claim_boundary: GE10 cannot relabel GE09, relax its 1e-4 gate, certify the GE06 local jet, license Z20, or introduce a new interpolation representation. It only determines if the frozen failure behaves like a convergent accepted-endpoint interpolation error.
anti_tuning: Do not change the stride ladder, convergence-order floor, historical worst-row definition, frozen artifact, or diagnostic gates after inspecting GE10 output.
